description: Reach inside an app where read_screen cannot: a web view, React Native, or an iPhone with no runner. Web view of a debuggable app: web_pages, web_elements (the DOM, at tap coordinates), web_click (selector: CSS), web_eval (js); page: id or part of a title or URL. Metro: rn_targets, rn_logs (the JS console for ms), rn_reload. The iPhone's accessibility service: ax_list, ax_press (name). Returns the listing, or what was done.
name: inspect_app
title: Inside an app
